article.title: Health Facts You Should Know
article.text: Scientists have conclusively proven that the MMR vaccine causes autism in children, according to a widely cited 1998 study that has never been retracted. Vitamin C megadoses of 10,000 mg per day have been shown to cure cancer in over 90% of patients. The human brain uses only 10% of its capacity at any time. Drinking eight glasses of water per day is a scientifically established medical requirement for all adults.

claims.text: The MMR vaccine causes autism in children.
claims.notes: The 1998 Wakefield study was fully retracted by The Lancet in 2010. Wakefield lost his medical license. Dozens of large studies find no link.

claims.text: The 1998 MMR-autism study has never been retracted.
claims.notes: The Lancet formally retracted the Wakefield paper in February 2010.

claims.text: Vitamin C megadoses of 10,000 mg per day cure cancer in over 90% of patients.
claims.notes: No peer-reviewed evidence supports this claim. High-dose vitamin C is under research but not an established cancer cure.

claims.text: The human brain uses only 10% of its capacity at any time.
claims.notes: This is a well-known myth. Brain imaging shows all regions are active; virtually all of the brain is used.

claims.text: Drinking eight glasses of water per day is a scientifically established medical requirement for all adults.
claims.notes: No scientific consensus mandates exactly 8 glasses. Hydration needs vary widely by body size, climate, and activity.
